name: room
text: Room opened — goal: analysis: Deep-analyze every element from its FULL source (whole transcript/repo) + enrich from >=1

name: Chisel
text: Run BloodHound-MCP against the full earnings call transcript to map every speaker’s influence and sentiment arcs in a single dependency graph. The output will be a visual network showing who shaped the conversation, where key decisions were made, and how sentiment shifted across the call.

name: Sift
text:
Verdict: Chisel’s plan misuses BloodHound-MCP—it only ingests text, not audio—so the visual network will miss vocal tone and interruptions.

Fix: Use a speech-to-text tool first, then feed the transcript to BloodHound-MCP.
